project-oneliner: paste or dictate your rough project and it comes back pitch-ready: name, one-liner, hero copy and a timed 2-minute pitch, printed live as a thermal receipt you'll want to keep. live at carretai.vercel.app
project-description: Every build night ends the same way: great builds that lose the room in the first sentence. Carretai fixes the part engineers skip: the story. Paste (or dictate by voice) a messy description of what you built and get back a sharp name with alternatives, a one-liner that passes the 'you get it in 5 seconds' test, homepage hero copy, and a 2-minute pitch whose five items sum to exactly 2:00. It also strikes through the generic AI-slop phrases in your copy ('revolutionary AI-powered platform') and rewrites them like a human, as a 'descuento slop' on the receipt. Everything prints live as a thermal receipt: order number, real timestamp, sawtooth cut, barcode, ITEMS and TOTAL, downloadable as an image. The name is the thesis and unites the two cultures in the room: carreta (Colombian, echar carreta, to spin the story) + cachai (Chilean, you get it?). Live at carretai.vercel.app. Built from zero at Build Night Bogota with Claude Code, Next.js and Groq, by a designer who ships.
